description: A member's read state in one channel.

last_message_id.description:
The channel's newest timeline message (omitted in READY, where the channel entry has
it).

last_read_id.description:
The read cursor: a comparator, possibly a synthetic id (mark unread writes
`message_id − 1`). Absent = nothing read.

mention_count.description: Unread mentions (a muted channel counts direct mentions only).

muted.description: The member muted the channel; present only when true.

seq.description: The member change-log head this state is current as of.

unread.description: Whether a message by someone else is past the cursor.

unread_count.description:
Since 0.10.0: how many timeline messages are past the cursor (the messages behind
`unread`: top-level ones and replies also sent to the channel, live, that the member can
read), capped at [`UNREAD_COUNT_CAP`]: `99` means 99 or more. `0` when `unread` is false.
Older servers leave it out (read as `0`; use `unread`).

title: ReadState
